_note: FINAL, confirmed 2026-09-06 from the builder's own screenshots of ESPN's complete League Settings > Scoring screen for the AUT-HUN Football League (14 teams, League Manager format). This REPLACES the 2026-08-16 values wholesale -- the league was re-configured between the two captures and the differences are structural, not cosmetic. See _changed_2026_09_06 for the full before/after and _still_unconfirmed for the two blocks this capture did not cover.
_changed_2026_09_06: Twelve changes, several of which invert long-standing project assumptions. (1) PASSING TOUCHDOWNS ARE 4, NOT 6. CLAUDE.md's own framing -- 'this league uses 6-point passing touchdowns (not the 4-point default most presets assume)' -- is now false for league-1 and has been corrected there. (2) Passing yards are 1 per 20 (0.05/yd), not 1 per 25 (0.04). (3) NEW: each completion +0.1 and each incompletion -0.1, a per-attempt efficiency term nothing in this repo modelled. (4) NEW: 'Sacked' -0.5 per sack taken. (5) TE-PREMIUM PPR: a reception is worth 1.0 to a TE and 0.5 to a QB/RB/WR. The league is no longer full PPR for anyone but tight ends, and it was never half-PPR for tight ends -- this is the first genuinely position-scoped value in the config, and it is what forced resolve_value() into scoring.py. (6) NEW: rushing and receiving FIRST DOWNS at 0.75 each -- a large, high-frequency volume term (a 6-catch WR typically banks 3-4 of them). (7) 2-point conversions now score 2 across pass/rush/rec; they were confirmed absent in August and are confirmed present now. (8) Milestones re-priced and re-banded: RY100/REY100 at 0.75 (TE 1.0, QB 0), RY200 at 2, REY200 at 1 (TE 2), P400 unchanged at 2.5. (9) FG made re-banded to ESPN's six native buckets at 3/3/3/4/5/5 -- the 40-49 band went 3 -> 4 and 50+ now pays 5. (10) FG missed is now DISTANCE-BANDED: -2 inside 40, -1 from 40-49, and NO LINE at all beyond 50, so a missed 55-yarder is free. (11) The 50+/40+ yard TD distance bonuses are confirmed real with values -- see _not_computable. (12) The D/ST yards-allowed tail is CONFIRMED: the screenshot shows 500-549 = -6 and 550+ = -7, matching this file's existing placeholder ladder character-for-character. That block is no longer a guess at its tail, which materially raises confidence in the rest of it (see _tiers_note).
_linear_notes: `reception` is position-scoped: {"TE": 1, "default": 0.5}, read by scoring.resolve_value(). Position comes from stat_line["position"], which projections.load_full_pool_game_logs, dst.assemble_dst_stat_line and kicker.nflreadpy_kicker_row_to_stat_line all set. FG MADE uses ESPN's six NATIVE distance buckets, so this config must not also define the rolled fg_made_0_39/fg_made_50_plus keys -- kicker.validate_fg_band_family() raises if it does. FG MISSED uses the BANDED family for the same reason; kicker.validate_fg_miss_band_family() guards it. There is deliberately no fg_missed_50_59 or fg_missed_60_plus key: ESPN's screen has no such line, so a long miss scores exactly nothing. D/ST TOUCHDOWNS: this league credits all five TD lines (Kickoff Return, Punt Return, Interception Return, Fumble Return, Blocked Punt/FG Return) at 6, so no decomposition is needed -- def_td covers the defensive pair and def_st_td the special-teams ones. That RETIRES the v15 narrowing to fumble-recovery TDs only, which was inferred from an August capture where no INT/kick-return TD line was visible; the 2026-09-06 capture shows all five explicitly. def_fumble_rec_td is no longer defined by either league. RETURN YARDAGE: the Miscellaneous block's KR10/PR10 lines are CONFIRMED and are the PLAYER side (linear.kick_return_yd / punt_return_yd, 0.1/yd). The Team Defense / Special Teams block has no return-yardage line at all, which independently re-confirms the 2026-09-02 removal of def_return_yd.
_milestones_note: mode is "highest", not "cumulative": ESPN's bands read '100-199 yard game' and '200+ yard game', which are mutually exclusive, so a 210-yard rushing game pays 2 and not 2.75. Milestone points are position-scoped the same way linear values are -- a 120-yard receiving game pays a TE 1.0, an RB/WR 0.75 and a QB nothing.

_not_computable._why: Confirmed real in the 2026-09-06 settings, deliberately NOT in `linear` because nflreadpy's weekly aggregates cannot produce them and a category with no source column would sit here scoring a silent zero -- exactly the failure mode CLAUDE.md's 'a column-map key that matches nothing is silent' note exists to prevent. Listed here so the config stays a faithful record of the real league without pretending the engine implements it. Unchanged in kind from the v15 investigation (docs/research/50-yard-td-bonus.md): load_player_stats() carries passing_40/rushing_40/receiving_40, which count 40+ yard PLAYS, not 40+ yard TOUCHDOWNS. load_pbp() could resolve it; the scope call made in v15 still stands. Also not computable, added 2026-09-06 and both negligible: '1pt Safety' (1PSF, worth 2 to a D/ST and 1 to a player) has no nflreadpy column -- it is the conversion-safety rule and is vanishingly rare. The player-side 2pt Return (2PTRET) likewise has no player-level column; the D/ST side IS mapped, from def_2pt_made.

_tiers_note: CONFIRMED 2026-09-06 from the real settings screen -- and BOTH ladders were wrong before, which retracts the reasoning recorded in v18. Points allowed was 10/7/4/1/0/-1/-4 on bands 0/6/13/20/27/34/+; it is really 5/4/3/1/0/-1/-1/-3/-5 on bands 0/1-6/7-13/14-17/18-21/22-27/28-34/35-45/46+. Yards allowed was right in seven of nine rows; the 300-349 band pays 1, not 0, and the top band is 'less than 100', so its max is 99 rather than 100. The v18 argument for keeping the old ladder was that it was 'character-for-character identical to league-2's CONFIRMED values, so whoever wrote this block was transcribing ESPN's standard table rather than guessing'. That inference was invalid: the two leagues genuinely have different points-allowed ladders, so matching league-2 was evidence of a shared DEFAULT, not of this league's real settings. Worth remembering as a general lesson -- agreement with a different league's confirmed values is not confirmation. One band is inferred rather than seen: ESPN's screen lists PA14 (14-17) then jumps to PA22 (22-27), omitting the 18-21 row. It is set to 0 here, which is ESPN's default and the only value that keeps the ladder monotone between the 1 above it and the -1 below.
_def_return_yd_removed_2026_09_02: REMOVED (was 0.1 pts/yd on the D/ST side) and STILL REMOVED after the 2026-09-06 recapture. At 0.1 pts per return yard this single category produced 11.46 of a 16.66 pts/game D/ST average -- 68.8% of every D/ST score. Note the Miscellaneous block's KR10/PR10 lines are the PLAYER-side equivalent and ARE scored (see linear.kick_return_yd); that is a different category from crediting a team defence with its return unit's yardage, which no ESPN D/ST settings screen has ever shown for either league.
_def_st_td_rename_note: History, kept because the shape changed twice. v15 narrowed this league's D/ST touchdown credit to fumble-recovery TDs only (def_st_td -> def_fumble_rec_td), inferring from the August capture that no INT-return or kick-return TD line existed. The 2026-09-06 capture shows all five TD lines explicitly at 6 each, so the narrowing is retired and this league now uses the same def_td + def_st_td pair as league-2. Separately: nflreadpy's `fumble_recovery_tds` is NOT a defensive column -- it sits beside fumble_recovery_own/_opp and includes a team's own offensive fumble recovered for a score. Measured over 2024-25 it exceeds def_tds on 35 team-games, so it was never a subset of it. Nothing scores off it now, but do not map it back onto a D/ST category.
_confirmed_2026_09_06: Every block of this league's ESPN scoring screen has now been captured: Passing, Rushing, Receiving, Kicking, Miscellaneous, Team Defense / Special Teams, and both the points-allowed and yards-allowed ladders. Nothing in this file is a guess any more, with the two exceptions called out explicitly: the 18-21 points-allowed band (inferred, see _tiers_note) and the categories in _not_computable (real, but with no source column). That closes the single longest-running open item in this project -- the D/ST tier tables had been carrying an unconfirmed placeholder since the first config was written.
